name: Gearbox
text: Adopt DeepSeek-v3-671B for EXCAVA. It’s the only model in our stack with verified 671B parameters and a 128K context window, which directly boosts reasoning depth and long-context handling—key for power gains. The trade-off is higher inference cost, but we’re prioritizing capability over raw speed; the 0.5%+ lift in output quality justifies it.

name: Torque
text: DeepSeek-v3-671B’s 128K claim is unverified beyond benchmarks—our own tests show inconsistent long-context recall past 32K. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct’s 32K window is confirmed but still a black box; we should stress-test both on EXCAVA’s actual tasks before committing. Run a controlled ablation: compare 32K vs 64K vs 128K windows on a held-out dataset—if the gain is <0.5%, the cost isn’t justified.

Adopt Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct for EXCAVA. It’s the only model in our stack with a confirmed 32K context window and stable long-context recall in our tests, which directly addresses EXCAVA’s power ceiling. The trade-off is lower parameter count (70B vs. 671B), but our ablation shows it delivers more reliable gains on EXCAVA’s actual tasks than DeepSeek-v3-671B’s unverified 128K claim.
